svg.title: A row costs a warp one line; a column costs 32
svg.desc: Left: the 32 lanes of a warp read a row of A, 32 consecutive floats, which fill one 128-byte line of 4 sectors of 32 bytes, every word used: 1 line, 4 sectors, 128 bytes moved, 100% used. Right: lanes 0 to 7 of the same warp write a column of B; each lane's float lands in its own line, and its sector moves 7 other words for nothing. For all 32 lanes: 32 lines, 32 sectors, 1,024 bytes moved for 128 used, 12.5%.
svg.text: A row costs a warp one line; a column costs 32
One warp, 4-byte floats, a 4,096 × 4,096 row-major matrix; counts derived by snippets/transpose_model.py.
Read a row of A: coalesced
1 line of 128 bytes, 4 sectors of 32 bytes
Bytes moved for the same 32 floats
Write a column of B: strided
The column write moves 8 times the bytes of the row read for the same 32 floats.
